jobs_results.description:
Perl, Continuous Integration, Ubuntu, KünstlicheIntelligenz, Open Source, Konfiguration, IT, Virtualisierung,Intrusion Prevention Systems, Linux, IT-Infrastruktur, ISO 2700x,Ansible, Softwareentwicklung, Kryptografie, Continuous Deployment,On-Premise, Machine Learning, IT-Security,Konfigurationsmanagement, bash, Puppet, Python, DevOps,GitLab

DevOps Engineer (d / m / w)

Are you interested in modern on-premise infrastructure,your own server room and the provision of stable CI / CD pipelines?

Do you enjoy working on Linux clients in an exciting workingenvironment? Are you looking for a committed team with whom you candiscuss things as equals and get sparring for tricky issues?

Thenwe should get to know each other! Our development department islooking for you as soon as possible in Leipzig as

DevOps Engineer (d / m / w)*

genua - Excellence in Digital Security

The genua GmbHteam ensures IT security at the highest level. Whether it's ITinfrastructures in the public sector, in... industry, at KRITISorganizations or in secret protection : We know the respective areasof application and offer a portfolio of tailor-made IT securitysolutions.

Our aim is to play a key role inshaping the development of IT security technology as a thoughtleader - especially in the context of current and future fields ofactivity such as AI, machine learning and post-quantumcryptography.

We offer our more than 400 employees excitingprospects in a company with a stable core business. Become part ofour unique team.

What is there to do?

After extensive training by experiencedcolleagues, you will work in a team of 17 in the softwaredevelopment of our "cognitix Threat Defender", a high-performanceintrusion prevention system (IPS).

The focus is on ensuring goodcommunication between development and IT as well as working on ourdevelopment environment.
• At ourcompany location in Leipzig, you will ensure the smooth operationof the development infrastructure and maintain on premise systems(GitLab), as well as open source based automation tools(Ansible / Puppet)
• You are responsible for theoptimization, automation, documentation and further development ofour development, build and test environments as well as CI / CDpipelines.

You will also work on the development of Linux-basedproducts.
• You provide proactive support forthe migration of IT infrastructure and are in continuouscommunication with IT.
• You also providesupport for the user environment, share your knowledge withinternal interfaces and take care of the provision and maintenanceof IT documentation.

What weoffer
• Extensive training byexperienced colleagues, a great team and appreciation at all levels
• Exciting prospects in a company with astable core business and great growth potential
• Flexible working hours and the option of mobile working
• Work-life balance through childcare duringholidays and support in the area of emergency childcare
• A company that welcomes employees' dogs
• Individual development opportunities and our "careersprint" career program as entry into a specialist or managementcareer
• The opportunity to learn fromexperts : we have committers working on a wide range of open sourceprojects
• Our GeekWeek : Here, twice a year,we can give free rein to our thirst for knowledge and creativityand pursue our own projects, away from our daily work routine
• Joint company events, discounted use ofsports and health facilities as well as fruit and drinks
• Company pension scheme
• Sustainable mobility is important to you? Us too! Wereimburse your public transport ticket, promote e-charging stationsat your home and offer various job bike models

What you bring with you
• A relevant degree or the necessary expertise.Career changers who have the relevant technical knowledge arewelcome
• Knowledge of DevOps architecturesand virtualization as well as experience in the design, developmentand operation of IT services
• Very goodknowledge of Linux (Ubuntu, AlmaLinux) and networking
• Good knowledge of configuration management tools such asAnsible and / or Puppet
• Good knowledge of theGitLab CI / CD platform
• Experience inprogramming and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Bashdesirable
• Solution-oriented and enjoytechnical issues and challenges
• Businessfluent in German (level C1), good English skills are desirable
• Structured and safety-oriented way ofworking, experience in the ISO27001 environment desirable

Apply to us - even if you don'tthink you can fulfill everything that is written here. Together wewill gradually develop your full potential!

You can find more information at www.genua.de

The jobtitle does not refer to the male version, but stands for agender-neutral description of the profession. At genua, people ofall genders are of course welcome.

The omission of gender-specificdifferentiations in the text merely serves to improve readability.

We look forward to receiving yourapplication. Please use our application form.

Please note our privacy policy

jobs_results.title: DevOps - Sector Farmacéutico (SaaS) - Vallés Occidental
jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Compañía multinacional líder en el sector farmacéutico desarrolladora de un software para tratamientos personalizados.

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?
• Desarrollar desde cero un marco de trabajo DevOps.
• Administrar y optimizar la infraestructura existente.
• Diseñar y mantener pipelines de integración y despliegue continuos (CI/CD).
• Supervisar y garantizar la disponibilidad y el rendimiento de los sistemas.
• Colaborar con otros equipos para implementar soluciones técnicas.
• Participar en la planificación y ejecución de proyectos de tecnología.
• Asegurar la seguridad y privacidad de los datos.
• Realizar pruebas y solucionar problemas técnicos.
• Proporcionar soporte y formación a otros miembros del equipo.

¿A quién buscamos (H/M/D)?

El/la candidato/a seleccionado deberá cumplir los siguientes requisitos:
• Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o campo relacionado.
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia en posiciones de DevOps o afínes.
•... Conocimiento de plataformas de nube, idealmente Azure.
• Familiaridad con herramientas de CI/CD como Jenkins, GitLab o GitHub Actions.
• Experiencia en scripting (Bash, Python u otros lenguajes).
• Experiencia con herramientas de automatización.
• Comprensión de conceptos de seguridad informática.
• Persona resolutiva con capacidad comunicativa y con ganas de aprender y aportar al equipo de trabajo.

¿Cuáles son tus beneficios?
• Salario: 35.000€ - 40.000€
• Modelo de trabajo: Híbrido, posibilidad de full remote.
• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional en un nuevo proyecto dentro de una gran compañía multinacional consolidada y estable.
• Ubicación: Vallés Occidental

jobs_results.title: Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Senior Cloud Engineers demonstrate the qualifications of an Engineer role to a higher degree, and are seen as mentors on their teams. Well versed in several technologies, they work independently and provide elegant solutions. They’ve started to lead technical discussions about architecture, infrastructure and frameworks, and consider the pros/cons of a technology choice based on benefits, scalability, maintainability, and project delivery performance.

You will report to a Senior Principal Engineer in the Cloud Engineering team. They will be your mentor as you grow in the team.

You Will:
• Use your software development skills to improve our automated platforms.
• Incorporate TDD/BDD patterns to improve the reliability of our internal systems.
• Develop infrastructure as code using Python, and Terraform.
• Build secure-by-design CI/CD pipelines.
• Work with and help improve container delivery platforms.
• Participate in after-hours and emergency support of systems and services to... maintain internal SLOs.
• Work with engineers in a global team and product teams.

You Have:
• 3 or more years development experience with Python, Ruby, Groovy, or NodeJS.
• Experience with core AWS services including VPC, ELB, IAM, KMS, EC2, Config, CloudTrail, CloudFormation, Lambda, and others.
• Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines, and design patterns.
• Experience working with Docker containers and Kubernetes.
• Experience with testing frameworks such as unittest, mock, and cucumber/gherkin.
• Eagerness to become an expert in the Cloud environment.
• Fluency in English.

Our Benefits:
• Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
• Retirement Plans
• Education Benefits
• Family Care Benefits
• Meal Vouchers
• Career Growth Programs
• Employee Referral Program
• Fitness reimbursement plan

Dow Jones focuses on Databases, Developer Tools, and Software Engineering. Their company has offices in Barcelona. They have a very large team that's between 1001-5000 employees.

You can view their website at https://www.dowjones.com

jobs_results.title: Azure DevOps Lead
jobs_results.description:
For one of the fastest-growing multinationals we are looking for an experienced Azure Lead/Architect to join an amazing project. If you are passionate about cloud technologies, automation, and continuous deployment, this is the perfect opportunity for you
• *Responsibilities**:

- Design, implement best solutions on cloud infrastructure on Azure
- Automate deployment, integration, and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes.
- Manage and monitor cloud infrastructure to ensure optimal availability and performance.
- Resolve technical challenges and issues related to cloud infrastructure.
• *Requirements**:

- Proven experience in designing and implementing cloud solutions using Azure services.
- Solid understanding of infrastructure as code (IaC) and experience with tools like Terraform or Ansible
- Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, continuous integration (CI), and continuous delivery (CD).
- Familiarity with monitoring tools such as DataDog, Grafana, or Prometheus.
- Azure... certifications are highly desirable.

What We Offer:

- Exciting and challenging project at the forefront of innovation.
- 100% flexible conditions of working in Madrid
- Continuous professional development and growth opportunities.
- Competitive remuneration based on your skills and experience

Who are we?
We are the creators of ClinSpark®, the world's first CDISC ODM certified Phase I eSource and clinical trial automation system. ClinSpark (now known as 'IQVIA Clinical eSource) improves the speed, quality and transparency of clinical research. We support a large and growing set of device integrations, enabling data collected from trial subjects, both onsite and remote, to be immediately available for review by study teams and the sponsor.
We're part of IQVIA - a world leader in using data, technology, advanced analytics, and expertise to help customers drive healthcare - and human health - forward.
Learn more here: IQVIA Clinical eSource Platform - IQVIA (https://www.iqvia.com/solutions/research-and-development/clinical-trials/clinical-trial-services-connected-devices/iqvia-clinical-esource-platform)
About you
- You find joy in helping your customers (biopharmaceutical, clinical research... organizations) who are doing important work.
- Creative thinker who strives to solve The Larger Problem when presented with a specific issue.
- Hungry to learn, self motivated, persistent, and detail oriented.
- Strong DevOps and Cloud technologies background. You should love building the tools to support software, collaborating with a cross-functional development team, and applying your creativity and focus.
- We care lots about your real world experience and less about years in industry or titles held.
About the role
- You'll be part of a very tight, highly professional team comprised of domain experts, former clinical research practitioners and engineers tackling all aspects of our business and operations.
- This position is responsible for designing, implementing and supporting technologies that underpin the ClinSpark platform. You'll help to create and manage standardised software development environments, driving improvements to our Developer Experience. For our customer production environments, you'll contribute to automating systems for deployment, monitoring and fault tolerance. You'll be directly engaged with customers on technical implementation questions, as well as troubleshooting their issues.
- Experience and familiarity with Cloud Platforms (preferably Amazon Web Services), Monitoring platforms (preferably Datadog), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, Fluxcd, Helm etc.), CI/CD (BitBucket, Gitlab, Github) are a must.
- This position is fully remote, although, candidates in the UK or EU timezones will be at an advantage.
Requirements
- Bachelors degree computer science, comparable field, or relevant work experience.
- Five (5) years related experience in DevOps, Cloud etc.
- Experience with clinical trials, core labs or medical devices is a plus.
Does this description fit you and do you want to learn more about the actual job? Reach out and talk to us!
What can we do for you?
You will become part of a distributed team, working in a remote capacity. This approach offers all of us a great deal of freedom and flexibility. We want you to figure out your own work-life balance. Family matters to us. You will receive a competitive salary package.
Are you interested in this position or you know somebody who could be interested, please let us know as soon as possible.
Working in the ClinSpark team can be challenging, it is certainly never boring, but above all, it is incredibly rewarding.
IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible - to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS)
jobs_results.description:
Time zones: EST (UTC -5) , MST (UTC -7) , ART (UTC -3) , UTC -4 , UTC -4:30 , UTC -3 , UTC -2 , SBT (UTC +11) , GMT (UTC +0) , CET (UTC +1) , EET (UTC +2) , MSK (UTC +3) , CEST (UTC +2) , BST (UTC +1) , JST (UTC +9) , CST (UTC +8) , WIB (UTC +7) , MMT (UTC +6:30) , BST (UTC +6) , NPT (UTC +5:45) , IST (UTC +5:30) , UZT (UTC +5) , IRDT (UTC +4:30) , GST (UTC +4)

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer for one of our clients who would be responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of cloud-based systems. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

What we are looking for:
• 5+ years of proven experience as a DevOps Engineer with a strong focus on AWS.
• In-depth knowledge of AWS services and architecture, including EC2, S3, Lambda, VPC, RDS, and more.
• Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) and automation tools.
• Experience... with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools (CloudFormation, Terraform).
• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development methodologies.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Nice-to-have:
• AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.

Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and manage scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS.
• Develop and maintain automation scripts using tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
• Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and other relevant tools to automate software deployment.
• Implement and manage containerized applications using AWS services such as Amazon ECS or EKS, and orchestrate containers using Docker and Kubernetes.
• Implement Infrastructure as Code principles to define and manage infrastructure resources.
• Set up monitoring and logging solutions using AWS CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail, and other relevant tools to ensure the health and performance of AWS resources.
• Implement security measures and best practices for AWS resources, ensuring a secure and compliant infrastructure.
• Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to understand requirements and implement effective cloud solutions.
• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans and ensure the resilience of cloud-based systems.
• Identify and address performance bottlenecks, optimize AWS resources, and implement best practices for efficiency.
• Create and maintain technical documentation for AWS infrastructure, deployment processes, and best practices.
• Provide guidance and mentorship to junior DevOps engineers and team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

What Proxify offers
• Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies
Discover exclusive long-term remote engagements at the world's most interesting product companies.
• Hand-picked opportunities, just for you
Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched engagements.
• Fast-track your independent developer career
Start small and gain more freedom to take on new engagements as you build your independent developer career.
• A recruitment process that values your time
Only one hiring process with the possibility of several positions, without any additional tests.

Salary Range: €3,840 - €6,400 per month

jobs_results.title: Back-end Web Developer + DevOps
jobs_results.description:
About Visca Web

At Visca Web we operate in the exciting and highly competitive online sports betting industry and our top objective is to deliver new players to our partners worldwide (operators such as Bet365, William Hill...etc) through our websites.

Our friendly and ambitious team consists of around 20 people in our Barcelona office. We all know each other’s names and being part of Visca Web is a great opportunity to make a noticeable impact.

We pride ourselves on having a truly international team (9 different nationalities) which is organized around tech development, product management, data analytics, SEO, Content production & Digital Marketing. Friendly startup feeling, but with structures and processes in place to grow fast.

Your Role:

We are looking for a Back-End Developer who can deliver quality software at a fast pace, as well as maintain and improve our AWS Infrastructure to help our websites and business grow. Our main sites are written in PHP. The ideal candidate... will also have experience with several of these platforms/tools/systems: WordPress, Agile methodologies, AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront, S3, SES, etc…), Docker,, Kubernetes, Google Tag Manager, Google Cloud, Google APIs.

We anticipate the role split will be roughly 75% back-end development / 25% infrastructure-related.

Your main missions will revolve around:
• Websites and structure performance enhancements (PHP applications speed optimizations, speed up deployment, monitor code behaviours...)
• Managing hosting infrastructure (AWS), migrations, enhancements of the infrastructure.
• Implement performance monitoring systems and create dashboards to track KPIs.
• Support the front-end team develop features on our websites.
• Support the data team to maintain the infrastructure and suggest new ideas.

Required skills/experience/mindset
• Experience with modern PHP (OOP, Composer…).
• Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming, refactoring, etc.
• Ability to maintain a MySQL database.
• Server management (via AWS or other) or at least a desire to learn about server/AWS infrastructure
• Team player with a positive mindset, willing to find reliable solutions that fit the projects’ needs and their constraints.
• The ability to communicate in English.
• (Bonus) Knowledge and experience with Front-End technologies/software (ReactJS, gulp, webpack, Bootstrap).
• (Bonus) Experience with Kotlin to work (in pair) with our data analyst and data developer.

We have great benefits
• A stimulating work environment where autonomy & responsibility are key.
• The excitement to work in a booming full digital industry.
• International products (USA, Canada, Africa, Latin America).
• Annual personal training/conference budget.
• Wellness benefits (Private health insurance, on-site massages, healthy snacks…)
• Cool and bright office in the 22@ district of Poblenou (bike storage, rest room, play room…)
• Flexible working hours.

This position is a full-time one, based in our Barcelona office. Possession of a valid work-permit for Spain is a must
